name: Chicken-foot Hut
descr: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.

data.motivesAndTactics: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample

features.name: Fast
features.text: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Pin
features.text: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to temporarily _Restrain_ the target. The Hut drags the _Restrained_ target when it moves.
